subject: Archery Game
text: Paying 20 Rupees to play and win the Archery Game in Kakariko Village awards the Big Quiver.

evidence.quote: Enter, and pay 20 Rupees to play...Win it to get the BIG QUIVER.

subject: rolling Goron
text: Stopping the small rolling Goron with a bomb in Goron City rewards Link with the Goron Tunic for free.

evidence.quote: Once you find him, plant a bomb so that it'll explode as he's running over it...After you do that, he gives you the GORON TUNIC, a special heat-resistant tunic that'll protect Link against extreme heat. You got this free, as opposed to the highly expensive one in the Goron City Shop.

subject: Sheik
text: Sheik teaches the Bolero of Fire across the fallen bridge in Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: You should encounter Sheik. He'll now teach you the BOLERO OF FIRE, a warp to here.

subject: soft dirt patch
text: Dropping a Bottle of Bugs onto the soft dirt patch in Death Mountain Crater releases a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: First, drop a Bottle of Bugs onto the soft dirt patch here to release a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 065 out of 100)

subject: rock
text: Riding the Magic Plant from the soft dirt patch in Death Mountain Crater leads to a rock with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Return here as Adult Link (using the warp) and ride the Magic Plant to a rock with a Piece of Heart on it. (HEART PIECES: 30 out of 36)

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the switch on the pillars to the left in Darunia's room releases a Goron and reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Jump on the pillars to your left, and step on the switch to release a Goron. Talk to him and he'll leave. Open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: room behind blue block
text: Defeating the Like Like from a distance past the flying floor tiles reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Now, get rid of the Like Like from a distance. (It'll take your shield and Goron Tunic if you don't!) Once it's gone, get the Gold Skulltula and return to the large room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 066 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the switch inside the bombed wall room releases a Goron and allows opening the chest behind him for a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Inside, step on the switch to release the Goron. Grab the SMALL KEY from the chest behind him once he leaves, then return once again to the large room.

subject: chest
text: Moving the blue block with the Song of Time leads to a room where stepping on the switch releases a Goron and yields a Small Key in the chest behind him.

evidence.quote: Return to where the blue block is, move it again with the Song of Time, and head through the door. Step on the switch to release this Goron, and grab the SMALL KEY from the chest behind him.

subject: enclosed area wall
text: Bombing the wall in an enclosed area on the left side of the boulder maze room reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In this next room, look around on the left side of this room and you'll find an enclosed area. Bomb the wall to find a Gold Skulltula. You should hear it. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 067 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Entering an enclosed door along the perimeter of the boulder maze room allows Link to free a Goron and take a Small Key from the chest behind him.

evidence.quote: Go a little more around the perimeter (being careful of the boulders) to see another enclosed area with a door this time. Head into the door, and free the Goron. Get the SMALL KEY behind him as usual.

subject: chest
text: Freeing the Goron in the cell on the opposite side of the boulder maze room reveals a Small Key in the chest behind him.

evidence.quote: Now, head to the complete opposite side of this room. You'll see another Goron cell. Free him and grab the SMALL KEY behind him.

subject: large chest
text: Shooting the silver eye switch with the Bow unlocks a room containing a large chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Grab the Recovery Hearts if you need them, and shoot the silver eye switch with your Bow. Head through the door that was opened, and open the large chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Pierre
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song at the upper part of the boulder maze room summons Pierre the Scarecrow.

evidence.quote: First, turn right and play your Scarecrow's Song, and Pierre should appear. Hookshot up to him, then Hookshot again to the platform.

subject: grate
text: Climbing up the grate past Pierre's platform leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Go around, climb up the grate, kill the Gold Skulltula, (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 068 out of 100), climb up another grate, and head through the door.

subject: abyss wall
text: Hookshotting the wall facing the abyss on the fifth floor collects a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Welcome to the fifth floor. Do me a favor and don't fall. If you look at the wall facing the "abyss", you'll see a Gold Skulltula. Find a good position and Hookshot it. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 069 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the fifth-floor switch lowers fire around a chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: Now, step on the switch, and it'll lower some fire around a chest for a limited time...Now quickly roll to the top and open the chest for a HUGE RUPEE.

subject: chest
text: Bombing the floor in the upper maze room and dropping down allows freeing a Goron to collect a Small Key from the chest.

evidence.quote: Jump across, eliminate the Torch Slug, and bomb the obvious-looking floor here. Drop down (though I prefer to climb down), head to the end, and free the Goron we saw before. Talk to him to make him leave, and grab the SMALL KEY from the chest.

subject: chest
text: Jumping to the corner ledge switch opens another Goron cell containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: This switch will open another Goron cell. Head to where the game points you to, talk to the Goron, and grab the SMALL KEY.

subject: large chest
text: Entering the door on the right of the fire maze room leads to a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: First, head right, stay towards the right, and enter the door you see there. (This is a maze of fire, so be careful.) Inside the door, open the large chest for the COMPASS.

subject: fake door
text: Bombing the fake door in the fire maze room destroys it and reveals the real door behind it.

evidence.quote: Get some stuff from the pots if you need it, and bomb the door. Yes, I said bomb it. It's a fake one that'll smash down on you if you try to open it. Head through the REAL door behind it and you'll encounter...

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Using the Hookshot pulls the Flare Dancer out of its flaming clothes so it can be damaged with sword slashes or an Advanced Spin Slash.

evidence.quote: In order to be able to hit this dude, you have to Hookshot him right out of its flaming clothes. Once it's out, start punishing it with sword slashes. It'll try to run away from you, but don't chase it. Just charge up your Advanced Spin Slash and release when it gets near you.

subject: large chest
text: Stepping on the smaller switch lowers the fire surrounding the large chest containing the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: Pick off the Fire Keese, and step on the switch. Fire surrounding a chest will lower. Quickly get there using the stairs. (the stairs are more dangerous, but it saves time) Open the large chest for the... finally...MEGATON HAMMER, the ancient hammer used to silence Volvagia from so long ago.

subject: chest
text: Moving the blue block with the Song of Time and pounding the rusted switch frees a Goron and reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Face the blue block and play the Song of Time to move it. Jump across to the other side and pound the rusted switch to free the Goron below. Drop down, talk to him, and open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: locked door room
text: Shielding against the flying floor tiles and defeating the Like Like from a distance reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In here, shield against the flying floor tiles, and kill the Like Like from a distance. Get the Gold Skulltula here, then continue to the next room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 070 out of 100)

subject: small chest
text: Defeating the second Flare Dancer reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote: You'll encounter another Flare Dancer. Defeat it the same way as before, and open the small chest for some BOMBS.

subject: chest
text: Pounding the rusty switch releases a Goron and opens a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Head into the next room, pound the rusty switch to release the Goron, and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

subject: Volvagia
text: Pounding Volvagia's head with the Hammer when she reveals herself stuns her so she can be repeatedly struck before retreating.

evidence.quote: Stay away from her(?) hair attack, and go up to her and pound her head down with the Hammer. Keep hitting her with the hammer until she retreats.

subject: Volvagia
text: Dropping down to grab onto the sides of the platform when Volvagia starts flying causes her to immediately return underground.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: When she starts flying around, drop down the sides slowly and you'll grab onto the sides as if its a grate or vine, or something. Doing this will make her lose her interest in attacking you and will go back underground

subject: Volvagia
text: Volvagia drops a Heart Container upon defeat once her head disintegrates.

evidence.quote: Wait until Volvagia's head disintegrates so you can pick up the HEART CONTAINER then exit using the light.

subject: Darunia
text: Darunia reveals himself as the Sage of Fire in the Chamber of Sages and awards Link the Fire Medallion.

evidence.quote: Darunia will show up in the Chamber of Sages with you and reveal to you that he's the Sage of Fire. In exchange for helping the Gorons, he'll give you the FIRE MEDALLION.
